description: This file defines a Polymer web component 'paper-ripple' that provides a visual ripple effect for material design interactions. It includes HTML template, CSS styles, and JavaScript logic for ripple animation, event handling, and customization options.

classes.name: ElementMetrics
classes.description: Helper class to compute and store element size and position metrics.

classes.name: Ripple
classes.description: Class representing individual ripple animations, handling drawing and interaction states.

methods.name: uiDownAction
methods.description: Handles user interaction to start ripple effect respecting 'noink'.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Starts the ripple effect, creating a new ripple instance.

methods.name: uiUpAction
methods.description: Handles user interaction to end ripple effect respecting 'noink'.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Ends the ripple effect for all ripples.

methods.name: addRipple
methods.description: Creates and adds a new ripple instance to the DOM.

methods.name: removeRipple
methods.description: Removes a specified ripple instance from the DOM.

methods.name: animate
methods.description: Performs animation frame updates for ripples.

methods.name: onAnimationComplete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after ripple animation finishes.
